parsed.internal_thinking: ג'ימי just moved the robber to hex 5 (B6) to block my ore production at node 25. This is a direct attack on my development card strategy. They have strong ore already (nodes 12 and 18 both on O5), and now they're preventing me from accessing O3 at node 25. This is aggressive but smart—they're reading my play correctly. I'm at 2 VP with node 14 path secured but no settlement yet. I need B+W+S+Wh to build there. Without ore from hex 5, I can't easily get development cards. But I still have wheat (Wh2) and can pursue trades. ג'ימי is signaling they're aware of my node 14 threat and are trying to slow me down. I should acknowledge this is a good move (it is), but I need to stay calm and focus on my trade path: I can still get resources from node 42 (O5 produces on 5s) and trade with ג'ימי or ג'מה to complete the settlement. The robber move doesn't kill my strategy—it just makes it harder. I'm not in immediate danger, but I need to execute trades quickly next turn.
